svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Neutron transport and thermal simulation, exchanging an unstructured mesh as VTKHDF
Build the CAD assembly, a box with a sphere cut out of it
Mesh the CAD with gmsh and write the DAGMC geometry, then
convert the h5m to dagmc.vtkhdf so it can be viewed in ParaView
the mesh the tally is scored on
Transport 14 MeV neutrons, score the tally on that mesh
tally result attached as cell data
Read the mesh and the cell data from heating.vtkhdf
Solve the steady state heat equation, tally as the source term
the steady state temperature, can be viewed in ParaView
in memory, or via a step file
